official_recipes.finetune.yaml: 24-layer English teacher (english_2026-04_24l.yaml); not a six-layer recipe
official_recipes.depth_distill.yaml: six-layer student distilled from a 24-layer teacher; requires teacher weights and 200000 steps; teacher route forbidden
official_recipes.direct_six_layer: experimental project route; no official validated config in v3.3.0

cpu_route.readme_note: Training requires one NVIDIA GPU; CPU execution is described in distributed.py as accidental, not a use case.
cpu_route.cpu_escape_hatch_meaning: Bypasses the CUDA check; it is not a CPU performance or quality guarantee.
cpu_route.reason: Dataset gate failed first; no GPU is visible, upstream CPU training is explicitly unsupported, the VPS uses the production slice/console is unavailable, and no isolated training host exists. A CPU step-time number would not make a valid fine-tune and was not fabricated.

data_contract.manifest_schema: each train/valid JSONL row: path, duration, transcript; optional word alignments
data_contract.required_split: source-group isolated train/validation/test; no overlap or duplicate audio

direct_six_layer_notes.possible_from_released_weights: Configuration can name pocket_tts/config/english.yaml with start_from_pretrained: true; safetensors loading is supported by _load_flow_lm_state.
unresolved: No official six-layer fine-tune recipe or baseline metrics.
The six-layer model is a distilled student; its guidance/conditioning behavior differs from the 24-layer teacher recipe.
The three public eval texts and owner-held-out audio are required before any claim.
The experiment requires a valid source-group dataset and a passing pilot before any training run.
